title: [clinic · EX-09] Survive an encoder upgrade
body:
> **Exercise clinic.** One long-running thread per exercise. Ask here rather than opening a
> new thread — the answers accumulate where the next person will look for them.
>
> **Exercise:** [`EX-09` — Survive an encoder upgrade](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/30-learning/exercises/ex-09-survive-an-encoder-upgrade.md) · difficulty 🔴

## What this exercise asks

Read the exercise first; this thread is for when you are stuck, not instead of it.

## Three ways people get stuck on this one

**1.** Writing new vectors into the existing version. A mixed-encoder index returns well-formed numbers for vectors that mean nothing to each other, and nothing errors.

**2.** Comparing before and after on different eval slices.

**3.** Declaring success on aggregate recall without checking per-class — an encoder swap usually helps some classes and hurts others.

## How to ask here

Post the **numbers you got**, the **config that produced them**, and **what you already tried**.
A question with a measurement in it gets answered in one round trip; a question without one
takes three.

If you have finished it, post the write-up in **Show and Tell** with the
`[solution · EX-09]` prefix rather than here — this thread stays for people who are stuck.
